notes.page_account: The author considers exactly two strata, closed X0 and complementary X1. He states an Artin dévissage description of a sheaf using F0, F1 and a map F0 to i0* i1*(F1). He states that constructibility amounts to local constancy on the strata, with accessory finiteness conditions, and that the equisingularity hypotheses make the resulting functor locally constant on X0. He then says the description uses the strata’s homotopy types, while the nature of the left-exact functor still needs explanation. He proposes an étale tubular-neighborhood topos in the schematic setting; he calls it interesting but says it is not associated to a scheme. The final word continues onto the next page.

check_events.outcome: For the preferred star reading, the composite has source sheaves on X1 and target sheaves on X0, so F0 -> i0* i1*(F1) has consistent source and target on X0. This does not prove the reconstruction theorem, local constancy, or the proposed tubular-neighborhood construction.
check_events.method: Read the diagram as inclusions i0:X0 -> X and i1:X1 -> X. Apply pushforward i1* from X1 to X and inverse image i0* from X to X0; compare with F0 on X0. This is only a local type-consistency check.
